title: Replace Tote Detect Sensor (LOTO tipper, disconnect M8, remove and remount sensor)
summary: Safely lock out the OptiSweep tipper, remove the Tote Detect sensor by disconnecting the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw, pull the sensor out, mount the replacement sensor using the M3 socket-head screws, and restart the operator station.
when_to_use: Use when the Tote Detect sensor must be physically removed and replaced on the OptiSweep tipper (sensor replacement task).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs physical lockout/tagout, sensor disconnection/removal, replacement mounting, and operator station restart.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO of the tipper before disconnecting and removing the Tote Detect sensor.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper and Tote Detect sensor

access_required: Physical access to the tipper and Tote Detect sensor
system_preconditions: Tipper is lockout/tagout (LOTO) before sensor disconnection/removal
external_references: Sensors section (page 89) for Tote sensor locations

visual_references.description: Manual maintenance diagram example for tipper LOTO/access and M8 hardware context (not Tote Detect sensor-specific).
Manual maintenance diagram example showing M8 electrical connector disconnect after LOTO (not Tote Detect sensor-specific).
Manual example that includes the pattern: LOTO → mount hardware → re-start the operator station (not Tote Detect sensor-specific).

steps.title: Identify the Tote Detect sensor location
steps.purpose: Ensure the correct sensor is accessed for removal and replacement.
steps.instruction: Use the manual’s “Sensors” section to identify the Tote sensor locations, then locate the Tote Detect sensor on the tipper/frame.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the correct Tote Detect sensor location on the tipper for the subsequent M8 disconnect and M3 screw removal.
steps.healthy_condition: The sensor you are about to service matches the Tote sensor location referenced by the manual’s “Sensors” section.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confidently match the sensor location to the manual’s Tote sensor locations (risk of disconnecting/removing the wrong component).

actions.label: Locate Tote Detect sensor
actions.exact_action: Identify the Tote Detect sensor location using the manual’s “Sensors” section (sensor locations referenced by this section).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if you cannot identify the correct Tote Detect sensor location without guessing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “7.3.2: Sensors… NOTE: See ‘Sensors’ on page 89 for sensor locations.”

steps.title: LOTO the tipper
steps.purpose: Prevent hazardous motion/energy while disconnecting and removing the sensor.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO of the tipper using the manual’s “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” procedure (page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a locked out/tagged out state before any sensor disconnection/removal.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed per the manual’s Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure before proceeding.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to disconnect the M8 connector or remove the M3 screw without completing LOTO.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if LOTO cannot be completed before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “7.3.2.3.1: REMOVAL 1. LOTO the tipper (see ‘Operator Station Lockout/Tagout’ on page 2).”

steps.title: Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw
steps.purpose: Free the Tote Detect sensor from electrical connection and mechanical mounting.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the M8 connector and remove the M3 socket-head screw securing the Tote Detect sensor.
steps.expected_result: The M8 connector is disconnected and the M3 socket-head screw is removed, allowing the sensor to be pulled out.
steps.healthy_condition: The sensor is no longer electrically connected (M8 disconnected) and is no longer mechanically secured by the M3 socket-head screw.
steps.failure_condition: The M8 connector or M3 screw cannot be disconnected/removed without forcing (risk of damage).

actions.label: Disconnect M8 and remove M3 screw
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sensor cannot be disconnected/reinstalled without forcing connectors or screws (risk of damage).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “7.3.2.3.1: REMOVAL 2. Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw.”

steps.title: Pull the sensor out
steps.purpose: Remove the sensor from the frame/mount after disconnection.
steps.instruction: Pull the Tote Detect sensor out of the frame/mount.
steps.expected_result: The Tote Detect sensor is removed from the frame/mount.
steps.healthy_condition: The sensor comes out without damage to the sensor body or surrounding grommets/cable routing.
steps.failure_condition: The sensor cannot be pulled out without forcing or appears stuck due to routing/grommets.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if pulling requires forcing that could damage the sensor or wiring.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “NOTE: It may be necessary to pull the grommets from the frame to make routing easier.”

steps.title: Mount the replacement sensor with the M3 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Re-secure the replacement sensor mechanically and prepare for reconnection and restart.
steps.instruction: Mount the replacement Tote Detect sensor using the M3 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: The replacement sensor is mounted and secured with the M3 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: The replacement sensor is firmly mounted using the M3 socket-head screws (no loose mounting).
steps.failure_condition: The sensor cannot be mounted securely with the M3 socket-head screws without forcing.

actions.label: Mount replacement sensor
actions.exact_action: Mount the sensor with the M3 socket-head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sensor cannot be mounted without forcing connectors/screws (risk of damage).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “7.3.2.3.2: INSTALLATION 1. Mount the sensor with the M3 socket-head screws.”

steps.title: Restart the operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the station back online after sensor replacement.
steps.instruction: Restart the operator station using the manual’s “Starting The Operator Station” procedure (page 66).
steps.expected_result: The operator station is restarted after the sensor replacement.
steps.healthy_condition: The operator station startup sequence completes successfully per the manual’s Starting The Operator Station procedure.
steps.failure_condition: The operator station cannot be restarted after installation.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station cannot be restarted after installation, stop and escalate to the appropriate support procedure for operator station startup.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “7.3.2.2.2: INSTALLATION 4. Re-start the operator station (see ‘Starting The Operator Station’ on page 66).”
Candidate evidence notes: restart operator station after sensor replacement.

success_criteria: Replacement Tote Detect sensor is physically mounted using the M3 socket-head screws.
Operator station is restarted successfully after the sensor replacement.
healthy_conditions: M8 connector is disconnected during removal and the sensor is reinstalled; after restart, the station startup completes per the manual’s Starting The Operator Station procedure.
No forcing was required to disconnect the M8 connector or remove/mount the M3 socket-head screw.
failure_conditions: Sensor cannot be disconnected/reinstalled without forcing connectors or screws (risk of damage).
Operator station cannot be restarted after installation.
escalation_guidance: If the sensor cannot be disconnected/reinstalled without forcing connectors or screws, stop and escalate to the appropriate support procedure for sensor replacement.
If the operator station cannot be restarted after installation, stop and escalate to the appropriate support procedure for operator station startup.
